text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 112, "unit": "minutes", "kind": "time", "span": "During a period of 112 minutes"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 40, "unit": "minutes", "kind": "time", "span": "played 40 minutes of commercials"}], "plan": [{"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "minutes of music = period minus commercials"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "music minutes per minute of commercials"}], "target": {"kind": "ratio", "scope": "the ratio of music played to commercials played, as music minutes divided by commercial minutes"}, "dismissed": []}
